## Host CPU Utilization High - Warning Alert

**Severity:** WARNING

The host's CPU utilization has exceeded the threshold. The host is the VM (the resource envelope the containers run inside), not the physical host; on GCP it is the GCE node. Sustained high host CPU means the containers are starved for compute and latency will suffer.

### Threshold note
`TODO: tune` - placeholder is 0.9 (90%). Adjust once we have a baseline from the Resource Usage dashboard.

### Metric name note
This uses the GMP-rendered name of the `hostmetrics` receiver's `system.cpu.utilization` metric (a ratio, unit `1`, so typically no unit suffix). The exact rendered name is confirmed post-deploy via `gcloud monitoring metrics list` and may need adjustment.

### Triage
1. Check `Resource Usage` dashboard - host CPU utilization + per-container CPU.
2. Identify the container(s) consuming the most CPU.
3. Check `API SLO` dashboard for a load spike.
4. Right-size services or grow the VM if usage is legitimate.

### Runbook
See `docs/RUNBOOKS.md` -> Infrastructure section.
